systemic_findings: Physical vehicle/set provenance must not be mistaken for release of the associated named character.
Generic species-role characters require species-aware resolution rather than arbitrary alien nearest neighbors.
Repeated digital appearances across LEGO games do not establish physical production.
Verified named identities with only very low-score catalog candidates should resolve to no supported physical match.
